Type of Funds: This project is privately funded, on private land for private use.
Scope of Work: Construction of a new 1-story freestanding emergency department in the city of Corpus Christi. The Facility is 14,686 SF and includes 16 exam rooms, 2 resuscitation rooms, 1 triage, 1 CT scan, 1 X-ray, generator, fuel tank, and helipad.
Design Firm Address: 500 N. Akard Street, Suite 3535, Dallas, Texas 75201
